title: Control of the eastern scenario route
body: The Iron Gate wants the eastern route held at any cost — something it values moves through the dark there.

title: The Warden's vigil list
body: The Silent Warden keeps a private list of incarnations under its protection. Names on it are never abandoned.

title: Debts owed in the plaza
body: The Ledger claims every incarnation saved in the plaza owes it a favor — and it always collects.

title: The Broker's ledger of names
body: The Whispering Broker records true allegiances. A name written there can be traded like coin.
